# ADR 0003: Control totals on every run

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Settlement reconciliation engine

## Context

A reconciliation that silently drops items is worse than none.

## Decision

Assert matched + unmatched value equals each side's file total; fail the run otherwise.

## Consequences

Provable completeness.

## Alternatives considered

Trusting counts.
